telegram_protocol_verification.verification: sing-box authenticated outbound request fetched a body-producing HTTPS endpoint with HTTP 2xx

external_sources.verification: sing-box authenticated outbound request fetched a body-producing HTTPS endpoint with HTTP 2xx

rotation.retention_policy: configured sources are never auto-deleted; low-frequency sources with safe endpoints remain eligible; sources without current profiles are rechecked on every run

trust_policy: source reputation is provisional; technical reachability and protocol success are measured separately; operator logging/privacy cannot be proven from client-side tests; new discoveries remain disabled until review
selection_policy: enabled catalog sources are re-evaluated independently; a source error does not block healthy peers; only DNS-safe, TCP-reachable and protocol-verified Telegram profiles are published; low-frequency enabled sources with reachable endpoints remain eligible
telegram_validation_level: URI safety + public DNS + TCP reachability + sing-box body-producing HTTPS endpoint failover; only verified profiles are emitted
connectivity_semantics: Telegram feed candidates must pass URI safety, public DNS, TCP reachability and, when enabled, a sing-box HTTP 204 request; external profiles are reported separately and require their own protocol-verification snapshot.
